Author: Yodhrin13
Name: HousingMarketShopper
Punchline: Automatically source and buy housing furnishings at the best cross-world price.
Description: Reads a MakePlace furnishing list, finds the cheapest market listings across all worlds via Universalis, then automates world-hopping and purchasing via Lifestream.
Changelog:
1.1.0
- New: Quick Add — build a list by typing item names with live search suggestions
- New: items sold by NPC vendors for gil are flagged in the Import tab so you don't overpay on the market board
- Fix: accurate pricing when no single world has enough stock — totals now sum the real cheapest listings across worlds instead of assuming the cheapest price for the whole quantity
- Fix: Universalis 504 timeouts greatly reduced (skip unused sale-history, smaller request batches)
- Fix: price fetch no longer spams errors when the plugin is reloaded mid-fetch
- Fix: world-price comparison popup shows per-world stock and the true total for the needed quantity
- Change: datacenters outside your region are now clearly disabled in Settings (cross-region travel isn't possible in-game)
- Fix: replaced UI symbols that rendered as blank boxes in the game font
